oeh_s.criterion: pooled lofo out-of-fold seven-class log loss of OEH current, primary panel
oeh_s.prior: class distribution of the learner in the primary meta-training rows
oeh_s.enter_cohort8: only if the chosen (T, eps) differs from (1, 0)
oeh_s.predeclared_fallback: probability floor 0.005 for every class, renormalized (not fitted)

conditional: B2 + legacy (prior_oeh_matched fields) on finite rows
oeh_2t.blend: convex blend w * 2T + (1 - w) * OEH current, w in {0.25, 0.5, 0.75}
oeh_2t.criterion: mdp5 out-of-fold log loss; the candidate must also not raise integrated Brier
oeh_2t.enter_cohort8: best of {2T variants, blends} if it beats OEH current on mdp5 log loss and does not raise its IBS; otherwise no 2T candidate

lce.fit: logistic s(b) = sigmoid(a + c log b), c >= 0, Bernoulli loss on the four posterior prefix success rates (x1, x2, x5, x10)

cb.fields: log n_hat = log SA + log clipped C*; log C*; log clipped C*; log intrinsic bound; unsupported flag (posterior-mean model, the G4 producer)
